description: Angular component and directive for displaying toast notifications using Angular Material snack bar and custom components, including animation handling and responsive positioning.

classes.name: ToastDirective
classes.description: Directive managing toast notifications display, including subscriptions to notification service, and rendering snack bar or custom toast panel.

classes.name: TbSnackBarComponent
classes.description: Component representing the visual toast notification, handling animations, positioning, and user interactions.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Initializes subscriptions to notification streams and manages display logic.

methods.name: showToastPanel
methods.description: Creates and displays a custom toast panel with animation and timeout handling.

methods.name: showSnackBar
methods.description: Displays a snack bar notification with positioning and auto-dismiss logic.

methods.name: shouldDisplayMessage
methods.description: Determines if a notification message should be displayed based on current state and target.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and destroys toast components.

methods.name: updatePosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the snack bar container based on configuration.

methods.name: updateContainerRect
methods.description: Updates the container's size and position based on parent element's bounding rectangle.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles user action on the toast, dismissing the notification.

methods.name: onHideFinished
methods.description: Handles animation end event to destroy the toast component.
